name: Vigil
author: Marc Ferro @keasbeexd
description: A security suite for Omarchy in five pillars: hardening, malware detection (with ClamUI), supply-chain checks (with Bumblebee), privacy and system care. Plain-language findings and fixes you approve one by one; root changes ask for your password in Omarchy's own dialog. Sends nothing anywhere.

barWidget.description: Security score in the bar; Harden, Detect, Supply, Privacy and Care tabs in the panel

schema.label: Check every (minutes)
schema.description: How often Vigil re-reads your settings in the background. Checks are local, read-only and take well under a second.

schema.label: Notify about new findings
schema.description: Send one desktop notification when a check that was fine starts failing. The notification only says how many; details stay in the panel.

schema.label: Weekly updates and scans
schema.description: Once a week each: refresh the lists Vigil checks against (known vulnerabilities from security.archlinux.org via arch-audit; known-malicious npm and Bun packages from OSV.dev via osv-scanner, which receives package names and versions, never files; your AUR packages from aur.archlinux.org), and run the background part of a Full scan (a ClamAV virus scan of your home folder, as you, and a Bumblebee rescan). Each step runs only once its tool is installed. Turn off to run them only with the Update sources and Full scan buttons.
